text:
alex: Heads-up — after OFED 5.8 rollout to eu-west-2 at ~07:12 UTC we've been seeing sudden RX buffering and huge NCCL allreduce tail latencies on the p4d fleet. Some jobs fell back to IB-over-TCP and throughput dropped massively.

maria: same here on p4d-12 and p4d-15. Reproduced locally with nccl-tests: allreduce bandwidth drops ~6x at scale. Short runs look fine, long runs hammering the network show the problem.

sanjay: any NIC stats yet? can someone paste `ethtool -S` / `ibv_devinfo` outputs from an affected host?

alex: pulled a couple of quick snippets from node p4d-12-03 — rx buffers climbing and no obvious link flaps:

```
# ethtool -S mlx5_core
rx_no_buf: 124578
rx_pkts: 9876543
tx_pkts: 8765432
rx_cqe_err: 0
```

```
# ibv_devinfo -v | grep -A2 "port 1"
	link_layer: InfiniBand
	port_state: PORT_ACTIVE (4)
	active_speed: 100 Gb/sec (4)
```

maria: also looked at the NCCL logs — a bunch of `NCCL WARN NET/IB` and then timeouts. Sample: `NCCL WARN Call to ibv_post_send failed: -12`

olivia: we just upgraded OFED to 5.8 kernel module set + mlx5 firmware on the eu-west-2 rollout group. Rollout completed at 07:10. No driver changes besides OFED stack.

alex: idea — could be a change in RX coalescing or buffer allocation behavior in 5.8 causing starvation under continuous allreduce with long messages.

sanjay: quick triage steps I recommend:
- stop heavy NCCL jobs on a few affected nodes
- capture `perf top` on hca process and `dmesg`
- run `ib_write_bw -S` / `ib_read_bw` for microbench
- collect `ethtool -S` over time to see rx_no_buf growth

maria: ran `ib_write_bw -S` on one node, bandwidth looks OK for short runs but memory/register pressure after ~90s shows errors. Posting the small repro logs to GCS.

olivia: ops, can we pause the remainder of region rollout and revert to OFED 5.7? We have a small canary set and it failed.

infra-bot: Detected incident: network-degradation-eu-west-2. Auto-pause enabled for OFED rollout. Notifying infra on-call.

alex: thanks infra-bot. @sanjay can you coordinate a targeted rollback for the 12 nodes with failures? We'll need kernel module unload and re-install of OFED 5.7 images — this will require reboot for the NIC firmware compatibility.

sanjay: on it. Plan: cordon + drain 12 nodes, revert cluster image to ofed-5.7 build, reboot, verify with `nccl-tests` and `ib_write_bw`. If green, uncordon. ETA 45m.

maria: temporary mitigation for running jobs: add NCCL env `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` to force TCP fallback for at-risk jobs (degrades perf but keeps them alive). Not ideal but buys time.

olivia: open ticket with HW vendor and OFED maintainers with logs/ethtool dumps/firmware version matrix. We should include: firmware version, mlx5 driver git tag, kernel version, OFED package list.

alex: agreed. I'm collecting nccl, dmesg, `ethtool -S`, and `/sys/class/infiniband/mlx5_0/ports/1/counters` dumps. Dropping link in the ticket when ready.

infra-bot: Rollback job scheduled for nodes [p4d-12-01..p4d-12-12] at 08:05 UTC.

sanjay: starting cordon on node p4d-12-03 now — will report back after reboot and nccl smoke.

alex: last note — if rollback fixes it, we need a stricter canary gating for future OFED/firmware changes (long-run allreduce smoke + rx_no_buf monitoring). Also add automatic policy to halt rollouts on rx_no_buf > X.

olivia: agreed. creating a postmortem checkbox list in the rollout playbook.

sanjay: p4d-12-03 back up, quick nccl-tests allreduce 1GB shows bandwidth recovered to expected baseline. Rolling through the remaining nodes.

alex: great — keeping this thread active. We'll follow up with vendor ticket and postmortem.
